title: Access and Work with Uppsala Conflict Data Program Data
text: ucdpR toolkit reproducible research data Uppsala Conflict Data Program. provides consistent R interface finding, downloading, importing, documenting, comparing UCDP datasets. Downloading data foundation, package designed grow around wider tasks applied researchers repeatedly encounter working UCDP data. package currently helps researchers: discover available datasets without hard-coding download URLs; download directly import current historical releases; pin exact versions reproducible research; preserve source URLs, versions, retrieval details, file checksums; retrieve dataset citation guidance; audit retrospective changes two releases. catalog read official download center run time, new UCDP releases generally require package update. ucdpR bundle redistribute UCDP data.

title: Access and Work with Uppsala Conflict Data Program Data
text: reproducible research, specify version explicitly record returned filename, source metadata, checksum. Imported objects retain details ucdp_source attribute. Cite dataset requested UCDP avoid silently replacing frozen research data. ucdp_cite("ged") retrieves current citation guidance.
code: library(ucdpR)  # See all current downloadable data files catalog <- ucdp_catalog()  # Search without remembering exact titles ucdp_search("georeferenced|candidate", catalog)  # Download a reproducible local copy path <- ucdp_download("ged", format = "csv", dest_dir = "data-raw")  # Or download and import it directly ged <- ucdp_get("ged", format = "csv")  # Inspect and download a frozen historical release ucdp_versions("ged", format = "csv") ged_24 <- ucdp_get("ged", version = "24.1", format = "csv")  # Monthly Candidate releases can be pinned in the same way candidate <- ucdp_get("candidate", version = "25.0.12", format = "csv")  # Select a specific file when a dataset has multiple variants brd <- ucdp_get("brd", variant = "dyadic", format = "csv")

title: Access and Work with Uppsala Conflict Data Program Data
text: UCDP datasets can retrospectively revised. ucdp_compare_versions() turns two official releases structured revision audit: cell-level old new values, set detail = "cells". large releases counts required, use detail = "summary" limit memory use.
code: comparison <- ucdp_compare_versions(   "ged",   old_version = "24.1",   new_version = "25.1" )  comparison$overview   # added, removed, modified, and unchanged rows comparison$variables  # number of revisions by variable comparison$added      # complete newly added observations comparison$removed    # complete removed observations comparison$modified   # keys and variables changed in matched observations

title: Compare two releases of a UCDP dataset — ucdp_compare_versions
text: dataset Dataset name alias accepted ucdp_get(). old_version, new_version Exact release identifiers. variant Optional dataset variant, "dyadic". format Download format. CSV recommended stable comparisons. key Character vector columns uniquely identify observations. NULL, key inferred verified uniqueness data sets. columns Columns whose values compared. default compares columns shared releases except key ignored columns. ignore Columns exclude value comparisons. release-level version column ignored default necessarily differs. tolerance Relative tolerance comparisons numeric values. detail Return "rows" (default), cell-level changes "cells", summaries "summary". old_data, new_data Optional preloaded data frames. Supply neither. useful releases already downloaded. quiet Suppress download messages? ... Additional arguments passed ucdp_get() releases.

code: old <- data.frame(id = 1:3, deaths = c(1, 2, 3), version = "1.0") new <- data.frame(id = 2:4, deaths = c(2, 4, 1), version = "2.0") comparison <- ucdp_compare_versions(   "ged", "1.0", "2.0", key = "id",   old_data = old, new_data = new ) comparison$overview #> # A tibble: 1 × 7 #>   old_rows new_rows matched added removed modified unchanged #>      <int>    <int>   <int> <int>   <int>    <int>     <int> #> 1        3        3       2     1       1        1         1  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ comparison <- ucdp_compare_versions("ged", "24.1", "25.1") comparison$modified } # }

title: ucdpR 0.3.4
text: Reframed package documentation around reproducible UCDP research workflows present future convenience functions, rather data downloading alone. Expanded README introductory vignette dedicated release- comparison workflow clearer guidance package scope direction.

title: ucdpR 0.3.3
text: Corrected synthetic HTML fixture used test catalog text extraction. fixture now spells “Yearly Datasets” correctly retaining nested-element structure guards dropped letters.

title: ucdpR 0.3.2
text: Corrected clean_text(): former regular expression removed literal lower-case letters n, r, t R’s default regex engine. Whitespace normalization now relies solely portable POSIX space class. Documented print() summary() methods separately method arguments longer produce R CMD check warning.

title: ucdpR 0.3.1
text: Fixed catalog titles losing lower-case n, r, t characters CSS-aware text extraction treated UCDP’s one-letter markup hidden. Restricted URL-based canonical naming genuine fallback cases, preventing auxiliary datasets relabeled similarly named core datasets. Applied robust text extraction citation discovery.

title: ucdpR 0.3.0
text: Added ucdp_compare_versions() audit retrospective changes two downloaded preloaded UCDP releases. reports schema changes added, removed, modified, unchanged observations, optional cell-level details numeric tolerance.

title: ucdpR 0.2.3
text: CSV imports now detect type-guessing failures automatically re-read full-file inference. correctly treats occasionally comma-separated UCDP identifier fields character without slowing every import default. Explicit readr controls col_types guess_max remain honored.

title: ucdpR 0.2.2
text: Removed non-ASCII character executable R code. Qualified utils::head() clean static code analysis. Excluded development-files CRAN source archive.

title: ucdpR 0.2.1
text: Fixed live catalog discovery UCDP served dataset headings different HTML level rendered page suggested. Fixed multiple-match diagnostic includes stable headline can tested reliably.

title: ucdpR 0.2.0
text: Historical releases now discovered UCDP’s dedicated archive. Added ucdp_versions() inspect downloadable versions selection. version now supports annual monthly Candidate release identifiers. Downloads imported objects retain source, version, checksum metadata. Improved detection historical dyadic conflict-level variants.
